title: Pravin Electricals (P) Ltd. v. Galaxy Infra & Engineering (P) Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Pravin Electricals (P) Ltd. v. Galaxy Infra & Engineering (P) Ltd., (2021) 5 SCC 671
content.facts: The Court considered whether documentary material established an arbitration agreement at the Section 11 stage.
questionsBeforeCourt: What enquiry may the referral court undertake to determine whether an arbitration agreement exists?
content.ratioDecidendi: The referral court examines the existence of the arbitration agreement on a prima facie basis within the statutory threshold.
content.holding: The decision illustrates the limited but necessary existence enquiry under Section 11.
content.relevance: Direct authority on the existence-of-arbitration-agreement enquiry under Section 11.
